title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg is Hiding the Dragon? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg has the dragon inside? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a dragon — but which one?!
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg right now — then let's count down! Three… two… one!
The red egg — oh no, it's just a rubber chicken! Not the dragon!
The blue egg — it's a tiny frog! Super cute, but still no dragon!
The GOLDEN egg — CRACK! Out pops a baby dragon! You found it!
Did you guess right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
